newsitem.title: USA: Barrett takes plunge in Gulf lease sale.
newsitem.headline: Barrett takes plunge in Gulf lease sale.

text.p: Barrett Resources Corp, an independent natural gas producer operating largely in the Rocky Mountains, plunged into the the bidding in the latest U.S. Gulf lease sale on Wednesday.

The Denver-based company placed winning bids totalling $36.3 million on 19 tracts in the western Gulf, including the lease- round's high bid of $13 million on a block sought by seven other producers in federal waters off the coast of Texas and western Louisiana.

Barrett's high bid was on High Island block A545, a tract also sought by Shell Offshore Inc and six independent producers in a sealed-bid auction held in a packed ballroom in New Orleans' French Quarter.
Barrett officials in Denver and Houston, where the company has opened an office to focus on Gulf drilling, were not immediately available for comment.
In addition to its lease on the High Island tract, Barrett bid $4.6 million on Matagorda Island block 652 and $3.9 million on High Island A364, a block that also drew eight bids.
On the day, Barrett submitted three of the ten highest bids in the sale.

In addition to boosting production in the Gulf, Barrett has been considering opportunities to expand into international oil and natural gas exploration to reduce its exposure to weak natural gas prices in the Rocky Mountain region.
Transmission constraints out of the Rocky Mountains, where differentials were sharply lower against Gulf Coast and midcontinent gas, pinched the company's earnings last year.
